Entity IDs **must** be passed inside the `filters` object — top-level `user_id` / `agent_id` / `run_id` are rejected with 400. `filters` supports the same operator set as V2 search (`AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `in`, `gte`, `lte`, etc.).
